name: coldbench
description: Measure whether a tool, skill or rules file actually helps a coding agent: generate exploration questions with ground truth from your repo history, then score recall and tokens across arms.

interface.shortDescription: Measure whether a tool actually helps a coding agent
interface.longDescription: Generate exploration questions with ground truth from your repo's own closed-issue history, run them across two identical arms (with and without the thing under test), then score recall, precision and tokens. No dollar estimates, no invented data.
defaultPrompt: Generate a question set for this repo's closed issues.
Score these two arms and tell me the recall and token delta.
Check whether my two benchmark arms are single-variable before I trust the result.
